bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree)" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=gaybbs | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 63
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 64
echo GAYBBS_ROOT=VERIFIED
echo GAYBBS_CONTAINER=ONE_RUNNING
echo USERBOT_SERVICE=ACTIVE
echo CURRENT_HEAD="$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --short HEAD)"
echo GSERVER_RUNTIME_NOT_REDEPLOYED=TRUE
